text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I made it onto the board, but...
Machan cannot be satisfied with just this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, I must not be satisfied.
Next time, I will definitely take 1st place...
choice_data_list: Today's race wasn't bad at all.
I'm counting on you to keep your word.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
It does seem I managed to get a little attention.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, mediocre results
won't leave a lasting impression on anyone.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To become an Ultra Super Mascot...
I need to get way, way more attention... desu.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *snort* Leave it to me. I'll put on a run that no one will ever forget for the rest of their lives.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We're going to train right away.
After all, Chan-me is the leading lady of the next race.
